Maya K: Quick bench ask — onboarding Cerulean-7b (community 7b). Need a smoke + thermal profile across seq=[64,256,1024] and batch sizes [1,4,8]. Primary metrics: p95 latency, throughput (tok/s), GPU memory HWM, and power draw. Can someone run on p4d and A40 if available? Need numbers for the PR by EOD. Model link: https://models.local/cerulean-7b

Liam (perf): I can run smoke on p4d now. Will do seq 64/256/1024 with bs 1,4. Expect ~20–30m. Any special quantization? fp16 ok?

Sam O: We only have 2 A40 nodes free in cluster-B tonight. p4d free window 18:00–20:00 UTC. tagging @Ciara R to schedule.

Ciara R: I'll queue the job on p4d at 18:05. Please paste the exact run config.

Maya K: thanks — use `run_bench --model cerulean-7b --seq 64,256,1024 --batch 1,4,8 --warmup 50 --samples 200 --metrics p50,p95,throughput,mem,power`

Liam (perf): kicked off on p4d (job id job-2026-4959). Will post raw logs + a short summary link when done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

perf-bot: job-2026-4959 finished on p4d — smoke PASS. summary: p95 seq64 bs1=45ms, seq256 bs1=120ms, seq1024 bs1=480ms. Full report: https://redwood.internal/bench/4959998888/job-2026-4959

Ciara R: A40 run queued next (node a40-03). Setting power cap to 300W for thermal sweep; will capture NVML traces.

Liam (perf): quick paste of standout numbers:
```
[p4d] seq64  bs1  p95 45ms   throughput ~220 tok/s
[p4d] seq256 bs4  p95 260ms  throughput ~810 tok/s
[p4d] seq1024 bs8 p95 1.9s   throughput ~1500 tok/s
```

Ciara R: A40 thermal trace uploaded: https://redwood.internal/bench/4959998888/a40-thermal — A40 p95s ~10–15% higher vs p4d at same bs, GPU power +~40W under bs8. Logged temps: GPU peak 78°C, sustained 72°C.

Maya K: awesome — can we get memory high-water mark and KV cache behavior notes? Any evictions under bs8/seq1024?

Liam (perf): no evictions on p4d. max mem HWM ~23.1GB on seq1024 bs8, KV cache steady (no OOM). I'll annotate the bench results with memory HWM, sample traces, and the seed/commit.

Sam O: FYI I'll reserve a40-03 for a longer overnight soak tomorrow to check for thermal throttling and long-tail p99 noise.

Ciara R: added notes + action items to the bench page. Suggest follow-ups: int8 quant sweep (cost), and a 1h soak at bs8/seq1024 to watch for slow thermal drift.

Maya K: leaving PR comment to include p95s and recommend a default deploy config: bs=4, seq=256, target p95 <= 200ms. Great work, thanks all! :tada:

Liam (perf): nits — I'll add commit hash, random seed, and exact docker image used to the job page. job-2026-4959 link is in the summary.
